# Templates tools

Draft, preview, localize, submit and track WhatsApp, RCS and SMS (DLT) templates.

**OAuth scope:** `templates:manage` · **Tools:** 10 callable · **Approx. context cost:** ~18.0k tokens

| Tool | What it does | Action |
|---|---|---|
| [`open_template_gallery`](#open_template_gallery) | Browse your templates in a visual gallery, filterable by channel, status, language and type. | Read-only |
| [`preview_template`](#preview_template) | Draft new template copy (including 2-6 A/B options) or preview an existing template, rendered as it appears on the phone. | Read-only |
| [`preview_flow`](#preview_flow) | Preview a timed multi-step message sequence on a visual timeline. | Read-only |
| [`save_template`](#save_template) | Create or update a WhatsApp or RCS template and submit it for approval, after you confirm the preview. | Writes |
| [`preview_multilingual_templates`](#preview_multilingual_templates) | Preview one WhatsApp template in several languages side by side (11 Indian languages plus English). | Read-only |
| [`create_multilingual_templates`](#create_multilingual_templates) | Submit the exact multilingual family you previewed for Meta approval, after your explicit yes. | Writes |
| [`save_sms_dlt_template`](#save_sms_dlt_template) | Register an already DLT-approved SMS template with Gupshup (asks for confirmation first). | Writes |
| [`get_template`](#get_template) | The full structure of one template as data: body, variables, header, footer and buttons. | Read-only |
| [`get_template_status`](#get_template_status) | Approval status of a WhatsApp or RCS template, with the rejection reason if rejected. | Read-only |
| [`delete_template`](#delete_template) | Delete an SMS template (asks for confirmation first). WhatsApp and RCS templates are deleted from the Gupshup console. | **Deletes data** |

## `open_template_gallery`

Browse your templates in a visual gallery, filterable by channel, status, language and type.

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp, SMS, RCS · **Opens panel:** `ui://meta-templates/preview`

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `channel` | `"all"` \| `"whatsapp"` \| `"rcs"` \| `"sms"` |  |
| `status` | `"APPROVED"` \| `"PENDING"` \| `"REJECTED"` | Omit for any listing: the unfiltered gallery already shows every template with its status badge (approved, pending, rejected). NEVER call once per status to summarise -- read the badges from one call instead. Pass a status only when the user asked for that review state ('show my pending templates'). |
| `name` | `string` | EXACT template name to find (e.g. 'rakshabandhan'). Matched with ==, so a label or phrase like 'RCS carousel templates' will NEVER match anything — omit unless the user said a template name. |
| `language` | `string` | Exact language code as stored on the template (e.g. 'en', 'en_US' — these do not cross-match). Omit unless the user asked for a language. |
| `type` | `"TEXT"` \| `"IMAGE"` \| `"VIDEO"` \| `"DOCUMENT"` \| `"LOCATION"` \| `"CAROUSEL"` | Omit for any listing: ONE call already returns every format (text, image, video, document, carousel) merged in a single gallery. NEVER call this tool once per type to 'list all' -- that renders duplicate panels. Pass a type only when the user asked for that format by name ('show my carousel templates'). |
| `limit` | `integer` | Pass ONLY when the user themselves said a number ('show my 5 templates' -> 5). Omit otherwise -- the gallery already shows everything, newest first. Words like 'latest', 'top' or 'all' are NOT a limit. |
| `offset` | `integer` | Never pass this on your own. Page through results only when the user explicitly asks for the next page. |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Browse the user's templates in a visual gallery, all connected
channels by default. To show ONE template the user already named, call
preview_template instead (each tool renders its own panel).
Pass a filter ONLY when the user asked for it: "list my templates" takes
none. Each one silently hides the rest -- type hides every other format,
status hides every other review state -- so an unrequested pair returns
an empty gallery that reads as an empty account.
(SMS channel only: the DLT gateway reports ENABLED/DISABLED, which this
tool maps onto APPROVED/REJECTED for the shared filter. WhatsApp always
uses real APPROVED/PENDING/REJECTED -- never say Enabled for WhatsApp.)

</details>

## `preview_template`

Draft new template copy (including 2-6 A/B options) or preview an existing template, rendered as it appears on the phone.

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp, SMS, RCS · **Opens panel:** `ui://meta-templates/preview`

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|
| `channel` | `"all"` \| `"whatsapp"` \| `"rcs"` \| `"sms"` |
| `name` | `string` |
| `template_id` | `string` |
| `language` | `string` |
| `draft` | `object` \| `object`[] |
| `category` | `"MARKETING"` \| `"UTILITY"` \| `"AUTHENTICATION"` |
| `sample_variables` | `object` |
| `brand_name` | `string` |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Draft new template copy or preview an existing template, rendered
visually. Any request to draft/write/compose a template is THIS tool,
not a chat answer. Existing: pass name or template_id
(template_id for SMS -- DLT names aren't unique; ids are strings).
New copy: pass draft instead (one content object, or 2-6 for A/B
options; name/category then label the draft). Build the draft only
from what the user asked for: map each piece of their content to its
correct component, never add a component (header, footer, buttons)
they did not request, and never move content between components. If a
request fits no component (e.g. a button that sends a reply message),
say so and offer what exists (URL or Call button) instead of adapting
it. Drafts: ONE call with
channel omitted previews every connected channel in one panel --
NEVER call once per channel; pass channel only when the user names
one. Preview only, nothing is saved; after the user confirms, pass
the SAME content object to save_template.
WhatsApp category -> type (honour the ones the user names, else pick
both from the use case): AUTHENTICATION = TEXT only, drafted as
{"type": "AUTHENTICATION", "otp": {...}}; MARKETING = TEXT, media,
CAROUSEL, LIMITED_TIME_OFFER (optional IMAGE/VIDEO header; COPY_CODE
button required when the offer expires), and the only category taking
a COPY_CODE button; UTILITY = TEXT, media, CAROUSEL, no
LIMITED_TIME_OFFER. Media formats: IMAGE, VIDEO, DOCUMENT, LOCATION, and
GIF (MARKETING only, supplied as an MP4 file).
MM WA Pay, Order Details and Order Status do not exist yet -- say so
rather than substituting a TEXT template.

</details>

## `save_template`

Create or update a WhatsApp or RCS template and submit it for approval, after you confirm the preview.

**Action:** Writes · **Channels:** WhatsApp, RCS

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|
| `channel` **(required)** | `"whatsapp"` \| `"rcs"` |
| `name` **(required)** | `string` |
| `content` **(required)** | `object` |
| `language` | `string` |
| `category` | `"MARKETING"` \| `"UTILITY"` \| `"AUTHENTICATION"` |
| `template_id` | `string` |
| `options` | SaveOptions |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Create (no template_id) or update (with template_id) a WhatsApp/RCS
template and submit it for review. Use only after the user confirms a
preview_template draft -- pass the identical content object; updates
replace the template, so re-pass media/footer/buttons to keep them.
category required when creating. What each channel cannot do, so say so
rather than trying: RCS templates cannot be EDITED (create a new name);
WhatsApp and RCS templates cannot be DELETED through the API at all
(Gupshup console only -- see delete_template). On error, check
get_template_status with the same name before retrying under a
different name -- the first attempt may have succeeded.

</details>

## `preview_multilingual_templates`

Preview one WhatsApp template in several languages side by side (11 Indian languages plus English).

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp · **Opens panel:** `ui://meta-templates/preview`

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` **(required)** | `string` |  |
| `category` **(required)** | `"MARKETING"` \| `"UTILITY"` |  |
| `variants` **(required)** | MultilingualVariant[] |  |
| `show_again` | `boolean` | Leave FALSE. The preview panel is shown ONCE per family; calling this tool again for the same content returns a short reminder, not another panel. Set TRUE only when the user EXPLICITLY asks to see the preview again ('show me the preview again'). |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

One WhatsApp template family in several languages, previewed TOGETHER
in a single panel — shown ONCE. Use whenever the user wants the same
template in 2+ languages (multilingual / translate / localize /
regional languages); single-language work stays with preview_template.
Same name for every language; supply each language's translated content
(en, hi, bn, gu, kn, ml, mr, pa, ta, te, ur). If the user gave no name,
suggest one from the content and show it here for confirmation. A
localized "Change Language" quick reply is added to every variant
automatically — do NOT add one yourself. The validated family is FROZEN
server-side under the returned draft_id: to submit, call
create_multilingual_templates with just that draft_id (never re-send
the content — what was previewed is exactly what ships). Submit only
after the user's explicit yes. Do NOT call this tool again for the same
family — not to 'confirm', not before submitting, not after creating.
Show the panel once, then submit or relay the create report as text.

</details>

## `create_multilingual_templates`

Submit the exact multilingual family you previewed for Meta approval, after your explicit yes.

**Action:** Writes · **Channels:** WhatsApp

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The family name you previewed. Pass the SAME name, category and variants you sent to preview_multilingual_templates — exactly like save_template for a single template. |
| `category` | `"MARKETING"` \| `"UTILITY"` | The same category you previewed. |
| `variants` | MultilingualVariant[] | The SAME per-language content you previewed. The server matches it to the draft the user already reviewed and submits that frozen copy, so what was previewed is what ships. |
| `draft_id` | `string` | Optional. Only the preview panel's own button uses this. From chat, submit with name+category+variants instead — you do NOT need a draft_id and must NOT re-run the preview to get one. |
| `submit_token` | `string` | Panel-internal token — ONLY the preview panel's own button sends this. From chat, OMIT it entirely. |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Submit a previewed multilingual family for Meta approval — call ONLY
after the user's explicit yes. Pass the SAME family you previewed:
name, category and variants (exactly like save_template for single
templates). You do NOT need a draft_id and you do NOT need to re-run
the preview to get one — the server matches your content to the draft
the user already reviewed and submits that frozen copy, so what was
previewed is exactly what ships. Only content that was actually
previewed can be submitted. Languages that already exist upstream are
skipped, so re-running after a partial failure creates only the missing
ones. Returns a per-language report (name, language, content, status) —
show it to the user in full as plain text; do not preview again.

</details>

## `save_sms_dlt_template`

Register an already DLT-approved SMS template with Gupshup (asks for confirmation first).

**Action:** Writes · **Channels:** SMS

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|
| `dlt_template_id` | `string` |
| `name` | `string` |
| `body` | `string` |
| `msg_type` | `"TEXT"` \| `"UNICODE_TEXT"` \| `"FLASH"` \| `"UNICODE_FLASH"` |
| `dlt_msg_type` | `"TRANSACTIONAL"` \| `"PROMOTIONAL"` \| `"SERVICE IMPLICIT"` \| `"SERVICE EXPLICIT"` |
| `default_mask` | `string` |
| `category_id` | `integer` |
| `template_id` | `string` |
| `masks` | `string` |
| `principal_entity_id` | `string` |
| `user_confirmed` | `boolean` |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

Mirror an already telecom-DLT-approved SMS template into Gupshup
(nothing is submitted for approval; body must exactly match the
DLT-approved wording, variables as {#var#} or @__123__@).
Create: dlt_template_id, name, body, msg_type (TEXT for GSM/ASCII,
UNICODE_TEXT otherwise -- infer, don't ask), dlt_msg_type (must match
the account type), default_mask (sender id), category_id (-1 for any
transactional class without asking; ask only for PROMOTIONAL).
Update: template_id plus only the fields that change; dlt_template_id
can't change. First call returns a warning to relay; re-call with
user_confirmed=true after an explicit yes.

</details>

## `get_template`

The full structure of one template as data: body, variables, header, footer and buttons.

**Action:** Read-only · **Channels:** WhatsApp, SMS, RCS

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |
| `template_id` | `string` |
| `channel` | `"whatsapp"` \| `"rcs"` |
| `language` | `string` |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

The full structure of ONE existing template as data: body and its
variables, header, footer, and every button (type, label, link). Use
this to answer structural questions about a template the user already has
-- does it have buttons or a QR button, what variables, what header --
without rendering a preview. For the on-phone visual use preview_template;
for only the approval verdict use get_template_status.

</details>

## `delete_template`

Delete an SMS template (asks for confirmation first). WhatsApp and RCS templates are deleted from the Gupshup console.

**Action:** **Deletes data** · **Channels:** SMS

| Parameter | Type |
|---|---|
| `channel` **(required)** | `"whatsapp"` \| `"rcs"` \| `"sms"` |
| `name` | `string` |
| `template_id` | `string` |
| `user_confirmed` | `boolean` |

<details><summary>Model-facing description</summary>

SMS templates only. Do NOT call this tool for WhatsApp or RCS: they
have no working delete (upstream limitation, verified live), so answer
the user directly that the template cannot be deleted here and has to
be removed from the Gupshup console. SMS: pass template_id (DLT names
aren't unique; the DLT-portal approval itself is untouched). First call
returns a warning to relay; re-call with user_confirmed=true after an
explicit yes.

</details>
